name: arckit-uk-food
description: UK Food Safety Overlay for ArcKit. Experimental and community-maintained. Covers England and Wales. Builds a small caterer's food safety documents from the Food Standards Agency's Safer food, better business for caterers pack: a business profile, the five sections of safe methods, the business's own methods, its allergen information, cleaning schedule and suppliers and contacts, the pack's blank diary and record sheets, a completion record, and sign-off by a named person. Requires arckit core plugin.
